ticks.note: The first tick is special: `start` and `late` take their first operand, 100. `pre(level)` has no previous tick to look at, so `before` is 0, the default of `int`.
From now on `->` gives its second operand as it is now: `start` = 6. `fby` gives its second operand as it was one tick ago: `late` = 5. `before` is also last tick's `level`: 5.
`now` and `start` follow `level` (9); `late` and `before` are one tick behind (6).
`level` stays at 9, so after one more tick the delayed outputs catch up: everything is 9.
